input.content:
argtree: unify the arg parser; rename the reserved `image` entry to `base`

Groundwork for making caos consumable by other projects (a typed `--base`
arg and a `:@@=` remote-git locator). See design/flake-inputs.md for the
full design and the staged plan; this commit is stages 1 and 2A.

Stage 1 — one arg parser.
  The CLI (lib.rs) and the .caos-expr evaluator (eval.rs) had two separate
  `--name[:type]=value` parsers that had drifted: the evaluator knew only
  `@` and literal, the CLI also knew `commit` and `tree`. Replace both with
  one shared `ArgType` enum + `parse_arg`, so the type vocabulary and its
  errors are defined once. The evaluator still *resolves* only literals and
  paths (+ `$VAR`); commit/tree parse and return a clear "not yet supported
  in .caos-expr", to be wired up with the new locator types.

Stage 2A — reserved entry `image` -> `base`.
  The runnable ArgTree's reserved worker-image entry is renamed `image` ->
  `base`, unifying it with the name a curry node already gives its slot.
  Moved together, since it is one wire/disk contract: client assembly
  (`base_arg_entry`, the secret-hash inserts, `args_tree_node`), the server
  unpack + sub-request build, the runner match + `disagreeing_seeder`, the
  worker runner (`/cas/args/base`, poll `required.base`),
  worker-common::own_image, llm-step's RESERVED_ARGS, the self-recursion
  scripts (std/flake-builder/worker, caos-tools/{build,test}.sh), the seed
  records (build-builtins.sh), and the docs.

  This RE-KEYS every cached result and the whole seed, so a stack must
  `nix build && caosd up` after pulling this (same as the socket-grant
  change). It does NOT change the user-facing grammar yet: the CLI
  positional and `run <image> --` in .caos-expr are unchanged. Collapsing
  those into `--base` is the next stage (2B).

  Gotcha handled: a git-docker image tree already carries its own `base`
  entry (the docker:// ref its layers delta over), so `args_tree_node`'s
  "has a `base` entry => args tree" would peel every image tree. It now
  returns None for any tree carrying `config.json` (the converter requires
  it; a `.`-name can't be an arg name).

Also: move the design scratchpad plan.md -> design/flake-inputs.md and
expand it into a handoff for the next session (status table, workflow
notes on the redeploy coupling, and 2B pointers).

Suite: 33/33 green (after redeploy).
